The '''Arg'garok''' was a large Gamorrean [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] designed for use by beings with tremendous strength and a low center of gravity, and was used by many [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] warriors. It required tremendous skill and physical strength to wield effectively. Non-Gamorreans often had great trouble using the Arg'garok and only the strongest and best-trained warriors could use it effectively.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] has the ability to wield two [[Arg'garok/Legends|Arg'garoks]] or any other ax-styled weapons at the same time.
